change.before: "port-forward to all pods regardless of readiness"

consequence.statement: Port-forwarding now only connects to ready pods; connections to previously reachable but non-ready pods will no longer be established.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 fixes port-forwarding to only target ready pods instead of all pods.
